title: ctenitis squamigera
intro: Ctenitis squamigera, commonly known as the scaly tree fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ctenitis squamigera include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiviral, and anticancer activities.
